purpose: Lean provider, receipt, notary, and deterministic gate boundary for the contained ConstraintBox Mini-Lev loop.

__init__.py.local_role: lean package marker; intentionally reduced from upstream exports

local_adaptations: signing.py and notary.py require an explicit ConstraintBox runtime key location; they never fall back to a home-directory path.

providers.py uses bounded standard-library HTTPS rather than an implicit requests dependency, rejects redirects, and provides fixed OpenRouter and NVIDIA adapter classes for controller-owned policy selection.
